`final class IndexedList<E extends IIndexedElement>`<br/>
**Implements:** `Iterable<E>`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.utils.list` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IndexedList.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/utils/list/IndexedList.java)

List kept sorted by the index of its elements, with equal indexes in insertion order.

## Description

The children of a node and the UIs of a bridge live in one, sorted by their `zindex`.
When the index of an element changes, the list sorts itself again at the next read.

- [Position and size](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/position-and-size/)
